metadata.title: tarot-spark
metadata.description: Draw cards and create an AI tarot prompt that asks what the cards suggest, explores two distinct interpretations, and names one reality check.

heading: Draw cards for better AI tarot answers.
intro: Get a prompt with two distinct interpretations and one reality check.
deckPreviewNote: A full {count}-card deck with every Major and all four suits. All cards share one art style.
personalizationIntro: Choose how many cards to draw and how the answer should feel. Feelings are possibilities, not facts.
contextHelp: Your situation stays out of shared links and analytics. It is included in the prompt you copy and will be sent if you paste it into another AI tool. Keep out names, contact details, and workplace secrets.
topicSelectorLabel: What do you want to explore?
topicSelectorDescription: Draw with a broad topic, or choose a specific question below.
questionPickerIntro: A question may adjust the topic above. Clearing it keeps that topic.
customizeCurrentIntro: Change the answer style or your private context for these cards.
editNextIntro: This result stays until you draw again. Change the next choices now if you want.

sharedReading.heading: Someone shared a tarot-spark reading.
sharedReading.intro: See the cards and AI question. Copy the question or draw your own cards.

instantReading.heading: Read the card flow
instantReading.intro: Create one connected interpretation from the drawn cards and selected reading options. Optional situation text is not sent or used.
instantReading.loading: Reading the flow of the cards…
instantReading.unavailable: The instant reading is unavailable right now. You can still copy the prompt below and continue in another tool.
instantReading.disclosure: This interpretation was created with generative AI.

promptReady: Your prompt for an AI tool is ready.
promptContextIncluded: Your situation is included in the prompt.
promptCopySuccess: Copied. Paste it into the AI tool you use to get the reading.
instagramImagePrepareFailed: The image could not be prepared. Select the Instagram icon to try again.
promptCopyBlockedAction: Copying did not work. Select the opened prompt below and copy it manually.
shareBlockedAction: Sharing did not work. Select the privacy-safe link below and copy it manually.
emptyBody: Choose a topic and draw now. You can also change the context, card count, or answer style.
disclaimer: Tarot content is for entertainment and self-reflection only. It is not medical, legal, financial, investment, or mental-health advice.
socialImageAlt: Share image with three celestial tarot cards and the tarot-spark name
